question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a documented public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract, or remain an internal bundled-plugin seam?
rationale: The branch adds two third-party-facing exports and raises SDK surface budgets; correcting the Slack block route does not determine whether external plugins should permanently depend on this API.

options.title: Approve Public Contract
options.body: Keep and document the generic progress marker after every Slack route is fixed and proven.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry the typed marker only through internal or bundled-plugin-owned boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve Public Contract
recommendation.body: Keep and document the generic progress marker after every Slack route is fixed and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the current Slack native-data architecture and the Codex app-server harness and has the strongest cross-boundary history for this contract decision.
